digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Friday, August 7, with nine scheduled meetings, a three-way collision at 11:00 AM, six urgent items, and two carry-overs. The day turns first on restoring the paused Preparer Change production line affecting roughly 3,000 matters, then on resetting the Amazon Connect critical path after the latest plan showed schedule slippage. Use the 9:00 AM Bonus Restructure kickoff and the 1:00-3:30 PM portfolio run to lock owners, protect the critical Court work, and prevent the compressed calendar from deferring decisions into next week.

items.label: Set the governance path for OAA Brain
items.detail: The overlap with Legal Change Management still needs a clear review path. Align with Jim on Legal and IT approval, required development, and which solution remains authoritative before more work advances.

items.label: Close the Latent Variables reply
items.detail: Review Yash's response and decide whether it changes the fieldwork decision or needs a concise reply before the weekend.

items.label: 9:00 AM - BD Comp/Bonus Restructure PM intro
items.detail: Sara will not attend. Use the kickoff with Dave, John, and Jhara to confirm scope, work in progress, timeline, known risks, and the next decision owner.

items.label: 10:00-11:15 AM - Project update and PM III interview
items.detail: Project Updates leads directly into Spencer Huffman's interview. Capture interview feedback promptly because the final 15 minutes collide with the Service Cloud session and protected spreadsheet work.

items.label: 11:00 AM - Three-way Service Cloud collision
items.detail: The Service Cloud Phase 2 leader Q&A overlaps both the interview until 11:15 AM and the full Jorge spreadsheet focus hour. Choose the live priority and preserve an owner for the other two commitments.

items.label: 12:00 PM - Last protected hour before the meeting run
items.detail: Use Blocked Space to close the production-pause and Amazon escalation decisions before five consecutive meetings begin at 1:00 PM.

items.label: 1:00-3:30 PM - EPMO, Laura, Salesforce, pipeline, and executive deck
items.detail: This continuous sequence is the day's main portfolio decision block. Carry forward only the material risks, assign owners in the pipeline review, and finish with a leadership-ready status deck.

items.label: Restore the paused Preparer Change production line
items.detail: Teams reports that removing Angel's wet-signature path requires a new Python script and has paused production for roughly 3,000 matters. Confirm the Business Application ticket contains the script, machine, errors, and requested work; assign the technical owner; and hold additional task-set launches until Legal approves the revised process.

items.label: Reset the Amazon Connect critical path and go-live
items.detail: The latest UAT plan is already about two business days behind, AWS timing remains unresolved, and Danny's sequence points to a possible September 3-7 go-live. Require the dependency-linked plan, AWS response and mitigation, daily standup time, and one leadership-ready date before EOD.

items.label: Set the Bonus Restructure project path at 9:00 AM
items.detail: Sara is absent from the PM introduction, and Jhara has been assigned because the work is urgent. Confirm the true scope, current work, timeline, known risks, and who owns the next milestone before the meeting closes.

items.label: Resolve the 11:00 AM Service Cloud collision
items.detail: Decide whether Jean stays in the PM III interview, attends the launch-readiness Q&A, or protects Jorge's spreadsheet work. Route coverage and capture the missed decisions before the afternoon meeting stack.

items.label: Prioritize the new critical Court work in the pipeline
items.detail: Maria raised Court hearing notifications and the Attorney Recommendation field to Critical, with CLR visibility and the unresponsive CLR workflow now High. Use the 2:30 PM pipeline review to rank them, assign owners, and state what must move first.

items.label: Prepare the SMS scripts for Monday's legal path
items.detail: The appointment-reminder and marketing opt-in flow still needs the Bucket 1 checkbox clarified, Ariel's Monday review, and Legal approval before templates go to IT. Use Laura's 1:1 to confirm the review owner and the handoff sequence.

items.label: Mar is out today
items.detail: Her all-day OOO block runs through 5:30 PM; route any portfolio dependencies to alternate coverage before the afternoon reviews.

items.label: Sara is in the Dublin office and misses the 9:00 AM kickoff
items.detail: Her travel block continues through today, and the Bonus Restructure invite explicitly says she will not attend. Make the kickoff self-contained and leave a concise decision record.

items.label: Monday opens with timecards, Legal alignment, and a noon focus hour
items.detail: Week setup starts at 8:00 AM, Legal Change Management follows at 10:00 AM, and Blocked Space at noon is the cleanest window for unresolved governance and SMS follow-through.

items.label: 2:00-3:30 PM - Three-part portfolio and roadblock run
items.detail: BD Portfolio Review, Legal Projects Portfolio Review, and Maria's 1:1 run back-to-back. Prepare the ranked Court and intake decisions before the sequence begins.
